records.subject: You're in -- let's get Vantage Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Vantage Partners* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days in, zero engagement: no project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:e7682a69], [email:5dd4bb19]). Accounts silent through two touches rarely self-start; 8 days remain and Pro status gives some motivation, so not negligible.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Vantage Partners moving
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Following up on my earlier note — I know launch weeks get busy. When you're ready, the simplest starting point is one real project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Whenever you want company, teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything on setup.

Best,
Chidi
